device.description: 12-bit 8 MSPS 2-input simultaneous-sampling pipeline ADC with 16-word FIFO and parallel uC/DSP interface
device.note: ths12082.pdf (SLAS271B) p.1 pinout, p.3 terminal functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.7 single conversion mode timing, p.8-10 conversion modes, p.11 output formats (Tables 3-6), p.12-13 FIFO, p.14-19 control registers (Tables 7-13), p.20 DATA_AV type (Table 14), p.21-25 bus timing (Figures 11-14)

registers.name: CR1
registers.note: p.18 Table 12: control register 1, reset 030h (DATA_P = 1, DATA_T = 1); bit 1 reads OVFL (read only, cleared when CR1 is read) and writes FRST (FIFO reset, write only)

commands.name: Write CR1 with RESET = 1
commands.note: p.18 Table 12: writing 1 to CR1 bit 0 resets the device and sets CR0 and CR1 to their reset values (0x401 in the configuration flow)

commands.name: Write CR1 with RBACK = 1 (debug mode)
commands.note: p.18 Table 12: debug mode; the first read after RBACK is set returns CR0, the second CR1

commands.name: Write control register 1
commands.note: RA1 = 0, RA0 = 1 on D11/D10, register value on D9-D0 (control register addressing table)

commands.name: Write control register 0
commands.note: RA1 = 0, RA0 = 0 on D11/D10, register value on D9-D0 (control register addressing table)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (ROC), p.7 (single conversion timing), p.8-10 (conversion modes), p.11 (output formats), p.12-13 (FIFO), p.14-19 (control registers), p.20 (DATA_AV), p.21-25 (bus timing)
notModeled: analog inputs, channel / differential / autoscan selection (CR0 bits 3-7), test voltages (CR0 TEST), internal/external reference and offset calibration (CR1 OFFSET) are stored only; the result is the 0 V code
CS1 (active-high chip select) is not modeled: tie it high; only CS0 (active low) selects the part

R/W mode (CR1 bit 6 = 1: WR (R/W) becomes a combined R/W input and RD is disabled) is not modeled: the bus stays in RD/WR mode (the CR1 reset value). The power-on state of RD/WR is unknown per the datasheet; the first access has to be a write
the RESET bit holds the device in reset until 0 is written to it; the model resets the registers when the write ends (RESET then reads 0)
debug read-back: the upper bits D11/D10 of the read-back words are taken from the register tables (CR0: 00, CR1: 01); after the first (CR0) read every further read returns CR1 until RBACK is cleared
CR0 PD (power down) is stored only; conversions continue in the model
pipeline latency (5 CONV_CLK cycles) and the CONV_CLK-to-read setup times are not modeled

codeFormat: CR1 BIN/2s = 0 two's complement (0 V differential = 000h), 1 binary (0 V differential = 800h, written "offset"); the power-on input is the differential channel AINP-AINM (CR0 DIFF0 = 1). A single-ended input at 0 V is below VREFM and reads 000h binary / 800h two's complement

16-word FIFO, its trigger levels (CR1 TRIG: 1/4/8/14 values for one channel, 2/4/8/12 for two), FIFO reset (FRST) and the OV_FL overflow output / OVFL flag: the model keeps no FIFO, DATA_AV asserts after every conversion and OV_FL is not driven

continuous mode (CR0 MODE = 0): every CONV_CLK falling edge starts a conversion, not timed (time 0); single conversion mode (MODE = 1): each CONVST falling edge starts one, timed as td(DATA_AV) 6.5 x tc + 15 ns (1 input) / 7.5 x tc + 15 ns (2 inputs, autoscan) with tc 133 ns max (p.7)
DATA_AV pulse width is half a CONV_CLK cycle (p.20): 62.5 ns at 8 MHz; level mode goes inactive at the first read (the datasheet: the first of TL reads)
pin name CONV_CLK (CONVST) as printed in the pinout (p.1); RESET pin is active low (overbar, p.1)
variants: THS12082C (0-70 C) and THS12082I (-40-85 C) share the datasheet
